correctness.rationale: All essential inferences verified independently by rebuilding Dic_n=(a,x|a^{2n}=1,x^2=a^n,x^{-1}ax=a^{-1}) as (e,k) model and recomputing. Group law associativity (1000 random triples for n=3,4,7,30), identity/inverses (0,k)^{-1}=(0,-k),(1,k)^{-1}=(1,k+n), orders o(a)=2n,o(x)=4,x^2=(0,n), x^{-1}ax=a^{-1}, |S|=4 symmetric 1 not in S, <a> cap x<a>=empty all hold. H=<x>={(0,0),(1,0),(0,n),(1,n)} order 4; right cosets H(0,k) size 4 indexed by k mod n, index n confirmed. Schreier action rep (0,i): i->i+1 (a), i-1 (a^{-1}), -i twice (x,x^{-1}=(1,0),(1,n)), neighbours i+1,i-1,-i,-i, loops iff 2i=0 mod n (i=0 always, i=n/2 if n even), row-sum 4, B symmetric (S=S^{-1} bijection) all confirmed numerically and analytically. Lemma1: rho_k(a)=diag(z^k,z^{-k}),z=exp(pi i/n), rho_k(x)=[[0,1],[(-1)^k,0]] satisfies a^{2n}=1,x^2=a^n,conjugation for n=3,5,12,50 all k (err<1e-10), unitary (D and X unitary), irreducible (z^k!=z^{-k} for 1<=k<=n-1 since n∤k, diagonal distinct + X swaps axes) and distinct (Tr rho_k(a)=2cos(pi k/n) strictly decreasing in k, n-1 distinct values), so dimension count 4*1+(n-1)*4=4n exhausts irreps (standard, delegated to Babai/dicyclic literature, fillable). Lemma2: D+D^{-1}=2cos(pi k/n)I, X+X^{-1}=[[0,1+e],[1+e,0]] with e=(-1)^k, i.e. [[0,2],[2,0]] if even else 0, so rho_k(S)=[[2c,2],[2,2c]] (even, eigs 2c±2) or 2cI (odd, double 2c) confirmed by direct eig vs formula (<1e-9). Lemma3: abelianization <A,X|2A=0,2X-nA=0> (matrix [[2,0],[-n,2]] det 4): n even -> C2xC2 via Y=X-(n/2)A, chars ±1 gives chi(S)=2ca+2cx in {4,0,0,-4}; n odd -> C4=<X>, A=2X, chi_j(x)=i^j,chi_j(a)=(-1)^j gives {4,-2,0,-2}; non-trivial <=0 confirmed. Theorem1 maximizer: even branches 2+2cos(pi k/n) max at smallest even k=2 (cos decreasing on [0,pi], pi k/n<pi), odd max 2cos(pi/n) at k=1, negative branches -2+2cos<=0 dominated, linears <=0<1<=2+2cos(2pi/n) (latter >=1 since cos(2pi/n)>=-1/2 for n>=3). Difference (2+2cos2θ)-2cosθ=4c^2-2c=2c(2c-1)>=0 with c=cos(pi/n)>=1/2, equality only n=3 (tie k=1 odd and k=2 even both 1, noted). No other 4 (2+2cos<4,2cos<=2). Gap 4-lambda2=2-2cos(2pi/n)=4sin^2(pi/n) via 1-cos2θ=2sin^2θ; sin x>=2x/pi on [0,pi/2] by concavity gives sin(pi/n)>=2/n, gap>=16/n^2. Brute maximizer over all candidates to n=200 matches k=2. Cayley adjacency for n=3..30 (reran candidate verify_dic.py: worst lam2 err 9.3e-15) plus independent extension to n=31,40,50 (err<1e-7, 4-regular simple 0/1 no loops, top 4 simple) confirms formula; floating point is corroboration only, proof analytic. Theorem2: abstract Ind_H^G 1 hook Reg_H inclusion is exact over C, so permutation (Schreier) adjacency (image of sum S) is subrepresentation of regular (Cayley) -> multiset inclusion valid. Elementary Fourier independently verified: T f(i)=f(i+1)+f(i-1)+2f(-i), T e_k=(w^k+w^{-k})e_k+2e_{-k} with e_k(i)=exp(2pi iki/n) holds to <1e-8 for all k to n=50; span{e_k,e_{-k}} matrix [[c,2],[2,c]], c=2cos(2pi k/n), eigs c±2; k=0 gives 4; n even k=n/2 gives 0 (c=-2, +branch 0, -branch -4 absent by 1-dim collapse). Hence lambda2(Sigma)=2+2cos(2pi/n) from k=1, 4 simple (c+2<4 for k>0), gap equality analytically, not just numerically (gapB==gapA to <1e-7, maxdist SpecB-to-SpecA <1e-7). Minor expositional shortcut: draft says 'with k'=2k these are exactly even-k' branches' which is imprecise for k=0 (k'=0 trivial) and k=n/2 even (k'=n out of 1..n-1 range, 0 obtained via linears {4,0,0,-4} not even branch); inclusion still true (0 in Gamma via linears, verified min|ev|<1e-8 for n=4,6,8,10) and abstract proof covers it, so not a fatal gap. Lemma5 trace: odd x-count 0 by <a> vs x<a> coset argument; 0 x's: sum e_i=±1, |sum|<=4<2n (n>=3) so sum=0 exactly C(4,2)=6; 4 x's: product a^{t4-t3+t2-t1}=a^{n(b4-b3+b2-b1)}, zero iff S even iff total parity even: 8/16; 2 x's: 6 patterns each reduces to n+(t-diff)±(e-comb)=0 with t-diff in {-n,0,n}, e-comb in {-2,0,2}, 0-diff never works (n>2), ±n needs e-comb=0 (2 choices) =>4 per pattern, total 24; verified by exhaustive word enumeration (4^4 words) split {0:6,2:24,4:8} for n=3,5, per-pattern 4, Tr2=16n,Tr4=152n exact vs matrix powers; n=2 gives closed4=64 not 38, proving n>=3 sharp for uniformity (gap formula accidentally still holds for Q8: spectrum [-4,0x6,4]). Spectral Tr4=sum lambda^4 matches (<1e-9). Draft honestly notes fourth-moment bound (152n-256)^{1/4} non-trivial only n=3 (~3.76) vs >4 thereafter, so consistency check not sharp proof. Cheeger: (d-lambda2)/2<=h for d-regular multigraph with loops in degree only holds since x^TLx=sum_{i<j}A_ij(x_i-x_j)^2 loops contribute 0; gives h>=2sin^2>=8/n^2, connected via gap>0. Proof vs experiment cleanly separated (§7 numerics audit exact proof).

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp/failed-search: (i) Babai 1979 Spectra of Cayley graphs gives general rho(S) character formula invoked, no dicyclic fixed-generator gap or Schreier quotient. (ii) Hoory-Linial-Wigderson 2006 survey gives Cheeger inequalities/background, no dicyclic certificate. (iii) Cheng-Feng-Huang 2019 Integral Cayley graphs over dicyclic (LAA 566) + Behajaina-Legrand generalized dicyclic work give eigenvalue formulas/integrality/distance-integrality/strong-regularity criteria; abstracts and draft citation confirm focus on integrality, no gap, no Cheeger, no Sch(Dic_n/<x>) quotient — representation ingredients overlap but gap extraction, k=2 maximality, Schreier family and trace audit absent. (iv) Hermon/Olesker-Taylor 2019 Cutoff for random walks on upper-triangular/Heisenberg groups verified by fetch: divergently many random generators (1<<log k<<log|G|), cutoff/mixing/coupling/entropy methods, no deterministic 4-generator spectral-gap lower bound via 2x2 interlacing/trace, disjoint setting. ArXiv searches corroborate: 'dicyclic spectral gap' 0 hits; 'dicyclic Cayley' 20 hits all on PST, regular sets, enumeration, distance-regular, relator games, presentations, automorphisms, Cayley maps — none on gap/Cheeger/expansion for S={a,a^{-1},x,x^{-1}} or Sigma_n. Hence exact lambda2=2+2cos(2pi/n), Sigma_n inclusion+equality, uniform 38 trace count and Cheeger packaging are not previously published as claimed. Pass is for novelty of statement, not for depth (depth assessed under value).

value.rationale: Correct and new but not independently worth finding later: textbook restatement + parameter substitution + unmotivated polynomial gain + enumeration. Given classical 2x2 irreps (admitted 'inputs are classical'), maximizing over k to get lambda2 is a 10-line trig exercise (2c(2c-1)>=0) any reader of Babai+dicyclic theory derives immediately; Schreier inclusion Spec(Sigma) subset Spec(Gamma) is immediate from standard permutation-subrepresentation theorem, and explicit Fourier diagonalization i->i+1,i-1,-i,-i to 2cos±2 is parallel to dihedral exercise; trace 38 (6+24+8) is elementary length-4 word count whose only use is consistency (draft admits fourth-moment bound trivial for n>3); Cheeger h>=8/n^2 is direct plug into known inequality. Dicyclic vs dihedral is dihedral-like parameter substitution: same 2D-block mechanism, Theta(1/n^2) polynomial decay, unique involution/C4 vs C2xC2/off-diagonal differences do not create new method or phenomenon. Gap ~1/n^2 is explicitly not uniform expansion (draft: 'not LPS-type expander'), so 'explicit expander/TCS/coding' motivation is generic with no downstream use; sharp constant 4sin^2 vs 16/n^2 rarely matters for non-expanders. Choice H=<x> to get n vertices is arbitrary among subgroups, tables n<=30 audit rather than prove, no transferable technique beyond known interlacing+trace. A later worker needing dicyclic gap would re-derive in minutes, not cite this packaging. Falls squarely under reject textbook restatements, mere parameter substitutions, tiny unmotivated gains, unexplained enumerations even if correct and new. Mitigations in topic.json (Schreier loops, trace check, reproducible audit) add packaging, not independent scientific value.
